tasks.title: Container recipe: pinned wheel set + engine fork built from source
tasks.goal: THE PRIMARY ENGINE LANE of spec ruling P4 (the nix wiring in the tree is the graduation lane — leave it alone). Write container/Containerfile and container/build.sh implementing IMPORTS.md sections 1 and 2 and spec claim 3.1 (specs/flashnext/spec.md#r3), designed for overnight iteration: the fork checkout and its build directory are bind-mounted volumes with ccache enabled so a one-line patch rebuild recompiles only what changed, and the image can be entered for edit-and-restart iteration without a rebuild. Containerfile: Ubuntu 24.04; python 3.12 venv at /opt/venv; install torch 2.13.0+rocm7.14.0 and torchvision 0.28.0+rocm7.14.0 and the matching triton wheel from the vendor stable index https://repo.amd.com/rocm/whl-multi-arch/ (record the exact resolved triton version); git clone --depth 1 --branch flashnext https://github.com/mecattaf/vllm and build it from source against those wheels for GPU target gfx1151 (relax nothing: the torch pin is satisfied exactly; drop audio extras rather than adding torchaudio); COPY container/rootfs/ into site-packages so the fn_ instrument modules land importable; write /opt/flashnext/build-info.json inside the image carrying the fork commit, torch, triton, and image build time. build.sh: run the packaging tests first, then podman build tagged flashnext:dev, then write results/receipts/build.json as {step:"build", status, ts, data:{torch, triton, fork_commit, image_digest}} with status fail on any error. Credit the recipe shape to the MIT toolbox recipe named in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md in the Containerfile header. Boundaries: touch only container/ and results/receipts/.
deliveredBehaviors: A reproducible image build from the fork at the exactly pinned wheel set
A build receipt the receipts gate can grade

Every module keeps an adaptation notice header naming the upstream file and license. Add tests/test_instruments.py asserting: py_compile passes for each module, each carries the notice header, and fn_offload_batch budget arithmetic matches the reference invariants (floor at max group size; promote counted in blocks). deliveredBehaviors: Instruments importable inside the image with FN_ kill-switches, default off
Notice headers travel with every adapted module

tasks.title: Pair-service orchestration: env doctrine, cluster up/down, first-light runner
tasks.goal: Write the host/ tooling and scripts/run-tp2.sh per spec claims 4.2, 4.3, 4.4, 4.5 and 6.1 (specs/flashnext/spec.md#r4, #r6), composing the disciplines in specs/flashnext/evidence/ds4-vllm-manifest.md section 5 and specs/flashnext/evidence/dotfiles-observed.md section 5. host/fn-env.sh: PYTHONHASHSEED=0; PYTORCH_HIP_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True,garbage_collection_threshold:0.85; HSA_ENABLE_INTERRUPT=1; inductor and triton cache dirs under the state directory, never tmpfs; NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME set ONLY to the Thunderbolt rails that carry a routable /30 IP (rail 0 thunderbolt0/10.99.0.x is guaranteed; rail 1 thunderbolt1 is trained-but-IP-unconfigured today per dotfiles modules/lowlat-cluster.nix and MUST NOT be listed until it has a peer IP — a peerless link-local rail in the list hangs RCCL bootstrap; the env file computes this from `ip -br addr` at write time and logs which rails it chose, rather than hardcoding both); NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1 UNCONDITIONALLY (an ibverbs device now exists on the rails from the pre-arm bake; without this pin RCCL autodetects verbs and silently rides unproven RDMA — sockets are the transport of record until the attended morning A/B, evidence host/rdma/ab-protocol.md); VLLM_RAY_EXTRA_ENV_VAR_PREFIXES_TO_COPY=FN_; VLLM_PLE_MMAP=1; a loud comment forbidding exports of engine defaults read through is-set probes. host/fn-cluster-up.sh: podman on both nodes (worker over ssh on the wire), distributed head on the coordinator and worker join, worker python pool capped small, a hard two-GPU gate before serve, then the serve process at tensor-parallel size 2 with eager execution, model directory /var/lib/local-models/flashnext-fp8, served name flashnext; reap stranded serve processes before start and gate on zero residue. host/fn-cluster-down.sh: idempotent teardown both nodes. host/fn-preflight.sh: byte-diff of both ranks' FN_ env, latency-hold device read on both ends, per-rail link-speed record, round-trip probe on both rails. host/systemd/flashnext-pair.service: oneshot, RemainAfterExit, ExecStopPost teardown, no install section. scripts/run-tp2.sh: preflight, up, two greedy 300-token completions byte-compared, residency read after 50 warmed decode tokens (GTT per rank from sysfs plus process RSS plus table page-cache residency), fidelity capture (fixed-prompt losses and frontier logits under results/), then a 262144-context probe, writing receipts tp2.json, residency.json, fidelity.json, context.json per the receipts-verify.py schema. Extend tests/test_repo_invariants.py-adjacent coverage with tests/test_host_tooling.py asserting the env file carries the doctrine lines and unit files carry ExecStopPost and no WantedBy install. Boundaries: touch only host/, scripts/run-tp2.sh, and tests/.
deliveredBehaviors: One command stands the pair service; one command tears it down; failure cannot strand ranks
First light produces the four receipts the ladder grades

acceptanceCriteria.description: Env doctrine present, units teardown-safe, all scripts syntax-clean, host tests pass.

tasks.title: Measurement harness: honest client and counterbalanced matrix
tasks.goal: Write bench/fn-stream-client.py and bench/run-matrix.sh per spec claims 6.2 and 6.3 (specs/flashnext/spec.md#r6). The client measures per-request time-to-first-token client-side AND scrapes the server metrics endpoint to separate scheduler queue wait from prompt processing — the reference harness's client published a prefill column that duplicated its first-token column (specs/flashnext/evidence/nix-strix-halo.md section 4.4); ours must not. Emit CSV with explicit column semantics in a header comment, plus a sha256 fingerprint of every completion's token ids. run-matrix.sh: arms interleaved A-B-B-A, three loads per arm, medians reported, depth series 0, 10240, 102400 tokens, speculative decoding on and off arms, results committed under results/ and a bench.json receipt {loads_per_arm, counterbalanced:true, arms, fingerprints}. Add tests/test_bench_client.py: feed the client parser a fixture with known queue and processing times and assert the two columns separate them. Boundaries: touch only bench/ and tests/.
deliveredBehaviors: A client whose prefill number is a measurement, not a proxy
A matrix whose every number carries its protocol

acceptanceCriteria.description: Client compiles, separation test passes, matrix script is syntax-clean.
